message: I've had enough of your transparent bad faith arguments, where you pretend to care about the poor and the marginalized, but really you're just a statist who wants to use the government to control people's lives. You're not a prophet, you're a con artist, selling your audience a bill of goods that you know is a lie. You're a master of the straw man, the ad hominem, and the shameless misrepresentation of opposing views. You're not even a decent troll, because you're not clever enough to make a coherent argument. You're just a hack, a charlatan, and a coward, hiding behind a mask of moral superiority while you peddle your statist agenda to the gullible. Your type has been a plague on this country for decades, and it's time someone called you out for what you are: a dishonest, manipulative, and despicable excuse for a human being. You don't belong in a serious discussion about this, or anything else, because you're not capable of having a serious discussion. You're a joke, and it's time you were laughed out of this conversation, and off the face of the earth.
